# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Assuming pagination ends when API returns an empty list.</uncertainty>

from typing import Dict, List, Set, Tuple

profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
spotify_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p.get('account_name')=='spotify'][0]['password']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username=profile['email'], password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

page_limit = 20

# Song library song ids
song_lib_ids: Set[int] = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        song_lib_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    page_index += 1
print('song_lib_pages', page_index)
print('song_lib_unique_song_ids', len(song_lib_ids))

# Album library song ids
album_lib_ids: Set[int] = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for alb in page:
        for sid in alb.get('song_ids', []):
            album_lib_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('album_lib_pages', page_index)
print('album_lib_unique_song_ids', len(album_lib_ids))

# Playlist library song ids (all playlists in your account)
playlist_lib_ids: Set[int] = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for pl in page:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
            playlist_lib_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1
print('playlist_lib_pages', page_index)
print('playlist_lib_unique_song_ids', len(playlist_lib_ids))

union_ids = song_lib_ids | album_lib_ids | playlist_lib_ids
print('union_unique_song_ids', len(union_ids))
print('union_sorted_sample', sorted(union_ids)[:15])

# Fetch details for each unique song_id
songs_info: Dict[int, Tuple[str, str]] = {}  # song_id -> (title, artists_joined)

for idx, sid in enumerate(sorted(union_ids)):
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = info['title']
    artists_joined = '|'.join([a['name'] for a in info.get('artists', [])])
    songs_info[sid] = (title, artists_joined)
    if idx < 3:
        print('song_detail_sample', sid, title, artists_joined)

print('songs_info_count', len(songs_info))

# Build CSV content with required headers

def csv_escape(val: str) -> str:
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

rows = ["Title,Artists"]
for sid in sorted(union_ids):
    title, artists_joined = songs_info[sid]
    rows.append(f"{csv_escape(title)},{csv_escape(artists_joined)}")

csv_content = "\n".join(rows) + "\n"
print('csv_lines', len(rows))
print('csv_content_sample_head')
print("\n".join(rows[:4]))

# Write to file system
file_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p.get('account_name')=='file_system'][0]['password']
fs_access_token = apis.file_system.login(username=profile['email'], password=file_pw)['access_token']

backup_dir = '~/backups'
apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_access_token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)

file_path = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'
# Overwrite existing file if present
content_resp = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_access_token, content=csv_content, overwrite=True)
print('create_file_resp', content_resp)

# Check file exists and show first few lines
show = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_access_token)
print('file_written_size', len(show.get('content','')))
print('file_first_lines')
print("\n".join(show['content'].splitlines()[:4]))

# Delete spotify account after backup
# <uncertainty>Assuming delete_account logs/terminates access without needing logout first.</uncertainty>

delete_resp = apis.spotify.delete_account(access_token=access_token)
print('delete_account_resp', delete_resp)
